#   file         the document, relative to the repository root
#   occurrences  how many times the rendered text must appear in it
#   reports      the report names, comma-separated, as the Examples job
#                render the template to the same text
#   template     the quoted text, with {rules} for "P of T" rules and
#                {checks} for "P of T" checks, where T counts failures too
# The document is compared with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space,
# so a claim that wraps across lines is written on one line here. A new
# claim in the docs is one new line here.
